name: ITGC-User-Role-Permission
query:
SELECT
    p.parent AS doctype,
    p.role AS role,
    p.if_owner,
    p.permlevel,
    p.read,
    p.write,
    
    p.create,
    p.delete,
    p.submit,
    p.cancel,
    p.amend,
    
    p.report,
    p.export,
    p.import,
    
    p.share,
    p.print,
    p.email
    
FROM `tabCustom DocPerm` p
ORDER BY p.parent, p.role
LIMIT 20000;
